subject: Re: BeaconAI MAP — consignment plan, access, and deletion window
messages:
From: Maya Sullivan <m.sullivan@beaconai.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: BeaconAI MAP request — dataset handover and usage constraints

Ava / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BeaconAI is excited to run a short pilot to validate inference quality for our product paraphrase use case. To move forward we need a concise MAP and clear controls for the exchange of evaluation materials (prompt pack + 2k test cases + sample model outputs).

Key asks from our side:
- MAP with milestone dates for provisioning, acceptance gates, and final return/destruction.
- A sandbox where the prompt pack and test cases can be run (ephemeral tokens, IP restriction).
- Clear usage constraints (no retention beyond pilot, no re-distribution, audit log access for 30 days).
- Basic SLA / availability expectations for the sandbox (we'll run automated regression tests).

Can you send a short MAP and the standard consignment checklist that includes deletion timing and evidence of deletion? We would like to start onboarding next Monday if possible.

Best,
Maya Sullivan
Head of ML Ops, BeaconAI
—
BeaconAI | m.sullivan@beaconai.com

Attachments: none referenced in this message
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Maya Sullivan <m.sullivan@beaconai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BeaconAI MAP request — dataset handover and usage constraints

Maya — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on the pilot scope. Attached is a concise MAP draft that maps milestones to concrete deliverables and acceptance gates. Highlights:

- Week 0 (provisioning): prompt pack + encrypted testcases shipped to a dedicated sandbox bucket; ephemeral ingestion token valid for 72 hours.
- Week 1 (validation): BeaconAI runs acceptance tests; pass/fail criteria documented in Annex A.
- Week 2 (QA & security review): joint review of results; minor fixes and a canary run.
- Week 3 (close): acceptance note, deletion trigger, and evidence package (deletion logs + hash attestations).

Security & usage constraints we included:
- Data is for evaluation-only; no persistence outside sandbox.
- All sandbox access requires MFA and source-IP allowlisting.
- Audit logs (console + S3 access logs) retained for 30 days; we can extend on request.
- Private enclave option if you require an on-prem connector (costed separately).

I attached: BeaconAI_MAP_v0.1.pdf (MAP draft), promptpack-sample-README.txt (overview + sample filenames), and SLA-Exhibit-A_draft.docx (baseline uptime & support cadence).

Next steps: please review and confirm the deletion window (we propose 14 days after acceptance), and flag any legal concerns. If that works we'll finalize the MAP and schedule provisioning for next Monday (17 May).

Best,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com

Attachments:
- BeaconAI_MAP_v0.1.pdf (PDF, 68KB)
- promptpack-sample-README.txt (TXT, 2KB)
- SLA-Exhibit-A_draft.docx (DOCX, 24KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Sullivan <m.sullivan@beaconai.com>, BeaconAI Legal <legal@beaconai.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BeaconAI MAP request — dataset handover and usage constraints

Quick note from me as we prep the MAP final:
- Agree with a 14-day deletion window post-acceptance as default for pilot. Suggest adding an optional 48‑hour escrow hold if BeaconAI needs to validate a suspected regression before deletion — documented as an opt-in clause.
- For auditability: we'll provide a signed deletion manifest (S3 object with deletion timestamps + SHA256 hashes) and a short ingestion log snapshot. Legal, please confirm if an additional attestation is required.
- Ben: please ensure the sandbox provisioning plan includes per-run token rotation and a kill-switch for the enclave (we don't want stale keys).

Ava — feel free to redline the MAP v0.1 to add the escrow hold language and I'll route to Legal for a quick OK. We should keep the MAP to 2–3 pages plus a brief annex with acceptance tests.

Marissa
VP, Partnerships & Pilots, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment referenced: redline suggestion (inline comments in BeaconAI_MAP_v0.1.pdf)
From: Maya Sullivan <m.sullivan@beaconai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, BeaconAI Legal <legal@beaconai.com>, Tom Peters <t.peters@prism-ops.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BeaconAI MAP request — dataset handover and usage constraints

Thanks, team — this looks good and pragmatic. A couple of quick confirmations from Legal:
- BeaconAI is OK with the 14-day default deletion window but requests the optional 48-hour escrow hold be available for business-critical regression checks.
- We need the signed deletion manifest and 30-day audit logs as described; please confirm the manifest format and delivery method (S3 pre-signed URL or e-mail delivery).

Operational ask: can we have a short pre-provisioning call on Monday (17 May) to confirm the ingestion token flow and the IP allowlist? Tom from our infra team will join. If you can send a calendar invite we will accept.

If you confirm delivery method for manifests and the optional escrow flow, BeaconAI will sign the MAP and we can onboard on 17 May as proposed.

Maya
—
Maya Sullivan | Head of ML Ops, BeaconAI
Attachments: none
